column3: (Informational cache analysis: hashed assets are cached for a year as immutable, HTML and other files are revalidated on each visit. Set in web/public/_headers.)

(Informational, HTTPS only: asks for no-store, no-cache and must-revalidate on every text page. The page and robots.txt are revalidated on each visit (Cloudflare sends public, max-age=0, must-revalidate) and the data files carry no-cache, both checked by tools/check_deployment.py after each deployment. no-store would also forbid the back-forward cache, for no gain: the site holds no personal data.)
